title: A rule for a shared resource
hook: Two stated cases: explore the common-pool payoff under two specified rules.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the common-pool payoff under two specified rules affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Payoff, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the common-pool payoff under two specified rules in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
